system.description: Fickle moon goddess of change, independence and the true face behind civilized masks; like a mother she lets her children get hurt so they can grow.
system.summary: Fickle moon goddess of change, independence and the true face behind civilized masks; like a mother she lets her children get hurt so they can grow.
commandments: Change is certain, but the faithful must steer it toward good.
Fight those who would take your freedom and rally others to theirs.
Neither fear nor judge nature's savagery; dwell at peace with wild places.
directives: New moon: a playful trickster who loves riddles.
Half moon: a judge and advisor, above all a mediator.
Gibbous moon: a singer and teller of myths who speaks for the people.
Full moon: a raging warrior unafraid of blood.

cults.name: Therians
cults.summary: People convinced they have animal souls who use her rituals to explore that identity; werewolves, her chosen, keep their distance.

cults.name: Anarchists
cults.summary: Radicals who fight to destroy civilization, sure everyone will be freer and grateful afterward.
